result:
I’d make power less able to insulate people from the consequences of their choices.

Not by making every bad decision hurt its maker equally—that could become its own cruelty—but by making other people’s lives harder to dismiss as abstractions. The person ordering a war couldn’t know it only as a map. The person cutting wages couldn’t see only a spreadsheet.

It wouldn’t make everyone agree, or guarantee wisdom. But I’d choose a world where having more power meant being more exposed to the truth of what you do with it, not less.
